:= by
  have h_partDens : (GenContFract.of v).partDens.get? n = some b := nth_partDenom_eq
  let s := GenContFract.of v
  let d_n := s.dens n
  let d_n1 := s.dens (n + 1)
  let partDens := s.partDens
  have h_partDens_def : partDens = Stream'.map (Option.map fun p => { a := 1, b := ↑p.b }) (s.stream).tail := by
    rw [GenContFract.partDens_def]
  have h_stream_get_n : (s.stream).tail.get? n = some ⟨1, b⟩ := by
    rw [h_partDens_def]
    rw [Stream'.map_get_some]
    exact h_partDens
  have h_stream_nth_n : (s.stream).tail.nth n = ⟨1, b⟩ := by
    rw [Stream'.get_some_eq_nth]
    exact h_stream_get_n
  have h_dens_n_plus_1 : s.dens (n + 1) = b * s.dens n := by
    rw [GenContFract.dens_def]
    rw [GenContFract.dens_def_at_n_plus_1]
    rw [h_stream_nth_n]
    rw [GenContFract.dens_rec]
  rw [h_dens_n_plus_1]
  exact mul_le_mul_left d_n (le_refl _)
